-################################################################################

# Libraries
```{r}
library(geosphere)
```

-################################################################################

# Import data

## Metadata
```{r}
metadata.sp.comm <- readRDS("../rds/metadata.sp.comm.rds")
metadata.gene.rar <- readRDS("../rds/metadata.rar.rds")
metadata.gene.rar$plot <- metadata.sp.comm$plot[c(1:16,18:24)]
```

## Spatial distances between plots
```{r}
plots <- read.csv2("../data/sample_plots_coordinates.csv", header = T, sep = ";", dec = ",")
```

## Bray-curtis distance matrix on Methylobacterium species composition
```{r}
species.bray.dist <- readRDS("../rds/genomes.bray.dist.rds")
```

## Bray-curtis distance matrix on Methylobacterium gene composition
```{r}
genes.bray.dist <- readRDS("../rds/GC.dist.rar.rds")
```


-################################################################################

# Species composition ~ space (plot and distance)

## Rearrange order of samples in 'plots' to match the 'species.bray.dist' order

```{r}
rownames(plots) <- plots$sample
plots.sp <- plots[match(rownames(metadata.sp.comm), rownames(plots)),]
```

## Create between plots distance matrix

```{r}
dist_plots.sp <- distm(plots.sp[, c("longitude", "latitude")], fun = distGeo)
dist_plots.sp <- round(dist_plots.sp, 0)
rownames(dist_plots.sp) <- plots.sp$sample
colnames(dist_plots.sp) <- plots.sp$sample
```

## Add random distance between samples of same plots (between 2 and 10 meters)

```{r}
set.seed(123456)
# number of plots
n <- nrow(dist_plots.sp)
# create matrix of random distances between 2 and 20
rand_dist.sp <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = n)
i <- upper.tri(rand_dist.sp) 
rand_dist.sp[i] <- runif(sum(i), min = 2, max = 20)
rand_dist.sp <- rand_dist.sp + t(rand_dist.sp) # copy values to lower triangle
# add the randomly generated distances to between plots distance matrix
dist_plots2.sp <- dist_plots.sp + rand_dist.sp
isSymmetric(dist_plots2.sp)
all(diag(dist_plots2.sp) == 0)
# round the final plot distance matrix
dist_plots2.sp <- round(dist_plots2.sp, 0)
```

## PERMANOVA test on species composition

```{r}
species.plots.perm <- adonis2(species.bray.dist ~ plot, data = metadata.sp.comm)
species.plots.perm
species.plots.disper <- betadisper(species.bray.dist, metadata.sp.comm$plot)
anova(species.plots.disper)
```

## Mantel test on species composition

```{r}
mantel(dist_plots2.sp, species.bray.dist, method = "spearman", permutations = 9999)
```

-################################################################################

# Gene composition ~ space (plot and distance)

## Rearrange order of samples in 'plots' to match the 'genes.bray.dist' order

```{r}
plots.genes <- plots[match(rownames(metadata.gene.rar), rownames(plots)),]
```

## Create between plots distance matrix

```{r}
dist_plots.genes <- distm(plots.genes[, c("longitude", "latitude")], fun = distGeo)
dist_plots.genes <- round(dist_plots.genes, 0)
rownames(dist_plots.genes) <- plots.genes$sample
colnames(dist_plots.genes) <- plots.genes$sample
```

## Add random distance between samples of same plots (between 2 and 10 meters)

```{r}
set.seed(654321)
# number of plots
n <- nrow(dist_plots.genes)
# create matrix of random distances between 2 and 20
rand_dist.genes <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = n)
i <- upper.tri(rand_dist.genes) 
rand_dist.genes[i] <- runif(sum(i), min = 2, max = 20)
rand_dist.genes <- rand_dist.genes + t(rand_dist.genes) # copy values to lower triangle
# add the randomly generated distances to between plots distance matrix
dist_plots2.genes <- dist_plots.genes + rand_dist.genes
isSymmetric(dist_plots2.genes)
all(diag(dist_plots2.genes) == 0)
# round the final plot distance matrix
dist_plots2.genes <- round(dist_plots2.genes, 0)
```

# PERMANOVA test on gene composition

```{r}
genes.plots.perm <- adonis2(genes.bray.dist ~ plot, data = metadata.gene.rar)
genes.plots.perm
genes.plots.disper <- betadisper(genes.bray.dist, metadata.gene.rar$plot)
anova(genes.plots.disper)
```

# Mantel test on gene composition

```{r}
mantel(dist_plots2.genes, genes.bray.dist, method = "spearman", permutations = 9999)
```
